# Dia Browser Security — captured 2026-07-03

Security as product feature: independent audits/pen-testing, Chromium engine, minimized data collection.

Agent/automation safeguards: explicit user approval before tab access or write actions; blocks LLM-generated URL auto-opening (anti-exfiltration); URL sanitization (links filtered before reaching AI to prevent instruction injection); form-fill/email-draft content shown in Dia-controlled views before submit; calendar events stay draft until confirmed; agentic mode prevented from navigating to other sites; sensitive fields (passwords) + critical action buttons hidden from agent. FAQ acknowledges residual prompt-injection risk (tone shifts/misinformation) while claiming exfil/unapproved-action outcomes are blocked.

Data: local encryption (chats/history/bookmarks), E2E-encrypted sync, AI partners contractually barred from training, no data selling, default ad-blocker.
Compliance: SOC 2 Type II (CY2025 audit, 2026 report); critical Chromium patches <48h; weekly releases.

## Last Fetched
2026-07-03 — Security page covers existing agentic safeguards (approval gates, exfil blocking, URL sanitization). No new dated announcement. Unchanged from prior.
